Class RainbowGumLogEvent

java.lang.Object
jdk.jfr.Event
io.jstach.rainbowgum.jfr.RainbowGumLogEvent
Direct Known Subclasses:
RainbowGumLogEvent.DebugEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.ErrorEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.InfoEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.TraceEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.WarnEvent
public abstract sealed class RainbowGumLogEvent extends Event permits RainbowGumLogEvent.TraceEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.DebugEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.InfoEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.WarnEvent, RainbowGumLogEvent.ErrorEvent
Base JFR event committed by JfrLogOutput, one concrete subclass per SLF4J / System.Logger.Level, so each level can be independently enabled/disabled and thresholded through a Flight Recorder configuration (.jfc) the same way any other JFR event type can.

Deliberately not shared with JfrAlertListener, which commits its own, separate RainbowGumAlertEvent instead - see that class for why.

throwable is a plain formatted stack trace string rather than JFR's own @StackTrace capture: that JFR feature records the stack at the point Event.commit() is called (i.e. inside this module), which is not useful here, so it is disabled (@StackTrace(false)) and the logged Throwable, if any, is captured as a field instead.

MDC / key values have no field of their own - JfrLogOutput's encoder renders them directly into message instead, since JFR custom event fields are limited to primitives, String, Class and Thread, so there is no direct representation for an arbitrary map.
